result.finding: No container orchestration files (docker-compose.yml, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts) exist in the repository. For production deployment, the deploy script (scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh) provisions and deploys both the web and worker modules to Azure Container Apps using the Azure CLI ('az containerapp create'), with Azure Container Registry for image hosting. For local development, infrastructure services (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ) are started individually using 'docker run' commands in scripts/startapp.sh.
